runs.question: How long do CFO Act agencies have to publish an AI strategy under the OMB AI memos?

answer.text:
The current answer is **180 days**. Under OMB M-25-21, the April 2025 memo, each CFO Act agency has 180 days from the memo's issuance to develop an AI strategy. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI. The memo also requires that strategies be made public: agencies must use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by 0MB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available.

The earlier memo set a longer window. M-24-10 gave CFO Act agencies within 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum to publish a strategy. M-25-21 replaces it: this memorandum rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (0MB) Memorandum M-24-10. So the 180-day deadline is the one that governs.

Two notes:
- The 180-day clock runs from April 2025, when M-25-21 was issued, so the deadline has likely passed. I did not find a date for the issuance itself beyond the memo's April 3, 2025 date, so I can't state the exact calendar date.
- The Department of Defense is excluded from the strategy requirement, and elements of the Intelligence Community are excluded as well. Consistent with sections 7225(d) and 7228 of the Advancing American AI Act, this requirement applies to CFO Act agencies except for the Department of Defense, and does not apply to elements of the Intelligence Community.

The current answer is **180 days**. Under OMB M-25-21, the April 2025 memo, each CFO Act agency has 180 days from the memo's issuance to develop an AI strategy. Within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for identifying and removing barriers to their responsible use of AI. The memo also requires that strategies be made public: agencies must use the AI Strategies template, to be provided by 0MB, and make their AI Strategies publicly available.

The earlier memo set a longer window. M-24-10 gave CFO Act agencies within 365 days of the issuance of this memorandum to publish a strategy. M-25-21 replaces it: this memorandum rescinds and replaces Office of Management and Budget (0MB) Memorandum M-24-10. So the 180-day deadline is the one that governs.

Two notes:
- The 180-day clock runs from April 2025, when M-25-21 was issued, so the deadline has likely passed. I did not find a date for the issuance itself beyond the memo's April 3, 2025 date, so I can't state the exact calendar date.
- The Department of Defense is excluded from the strategy requirement, and elements of the Intelligence Community are excluded as well. Consistent with sections 7225(d) and 7228 of the Advancing American AI Act, this requirement applies to CFO Act agencies except for the Department of Defense, and does not apply to elements of the Intelligence Community.
